description: MCP Server Configurations for YourDaddy AI Assistant

filesystem.name: filesystem
filesystem.description: Access local file system - read, write, search files and directories

postgres.name: postgres
postgres.description: PostgreSQL database access for queries and data management
postgres.notes: Install with: pip install mcp-server-postgres. Update connection string as needed.

github.name: github
github.description: GitHub integration - repos, issues, PRs, code search
github.notes: Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable. Install with: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-github

sqlite.name: sqlite
sqlite.description: SQLite database access for local data storage

google-drive.name: google-drive
google-drive.description: Google Drive integration - read/write files, manage folders

slack.name: slack
slack.description: Slack integration - send messages, read channels, manage workspace
slack.notes: Requires Slack bot token and team ID

brave-search.name: brave-search
brave-search.description: Brave Search API for web search capabilities
brave-search.notes: Requires Brave Search API key from https://brave.com/search/api/

memory.name: memory
memory.description: Persistent memory/knowledge graph for AI context
memory.notes: Enables long-term memory and context retention

puppeteer.name: puppeteer
puppeteer.description: Browser automation for web scraping and testing
puppeteer.notes: Headless browser automation. Install with: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer

sequential-thinking.name: sequential-thinking
sequential-thinking.notes: Improves AI reasoning for complex problems

chrome-devtools.name: chrome-devtools
chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools MCP for browser debugging and inspection
chrome-devtools.notes: Use VS Code's Get DevTools MCP flow or run via npx chrome-devtools-mcp. The old @modelcontextprotocol/server-chrome-devtools package does not exist.

notes: Environment variables in ${} format will be replaced from system env or .env file
Install required MCP servers before enabling them
Some servers require API keys or credentials - check the notes field
Add custom servers by following the same schema structure
